descs: The place where Light appeared. A dim ember flickers in the endless dark, yearning to grow.
Echoes of forgotten existence. The Void murmurs here, trying to lull the light back to sleep.
Beautiful, but hides danger. A massive threshold woven from stellar dust and forgotten gravity.
Lost technological wonders hum with ancient, dangerous energy.
The Darkness leaks here. Falling eternally through a beautiful, deadly silence.
A tear in the cosmic fabric where terrifying entities cross over.
The heart cracked by conflict. Time and space distort. Reality itself is your enemy here.
Your voice is not your own. The point of no return. The dark pulls with impossible strength.
A ruined safe haven that failed to protect the light.
The final destination. Absolute darkness and blinding light crash together.
A hidden cache of explosive potential. Rare anomalies gestate here.
A loop in time, holding secrets from a past that never was.
A forgotten crucible where light was once weaponized. Its purging resonance still echoes.
A shrine to endless motion. Those who take a life here inherit its remaining momentum.
A shimmering pocket of raw void-essence, waiting to be harvested by a nimble spark.
